summary: A 9th-level conjuration spell that can duplicate lower-level spells or produce broader reality-altering effects with stress and risk.

utility_effects.name: Duplicate lower-level spell
utility_effects.effect: Can duplicate any spell of 8th level or lower without meeting requirements including costly components.
utility_effects.raw_text: The basic use of this spell is to duplicate any other spell of 8th level or lower.

utility_effects.name: Greater wish
utility_effects.effect: Can attempt broader effects such as creating objects, healing many creatures, granting resistances, immunity to one spell/effect, undoing recent events, or other DM-adjudicated outcomes.
utility_effects.raw_text: You might be able to achieve something beyond the scope of the above examples.

restrictions.description: Using Wish for anything other than duplicating a lower-level spell causes stress penalties and a chance to lose ability to cast Wish again.
restrictions.raw_text: The stress of casting this spell to produce any effect other than duplicating another spell weakens you.

restrictions.description: Greater effects are DM-adjudicated and may fail, partially work, or produce unforeseen consequences.
restrictions.raw_text: The DM has great latitude in ruling what occurs in such an instance.

normalized_data.raw_effect_text: Can duplicate any 8th-level or lower spell without requirements. Alternatively, can attempt major effects like creating objects, healing, resistance, immunity, undoing recent events, or other reality changes, with stress and possible loss of future Wish casting.

review_reasons: Requires special-case spell duplication engine, component bypass, broad DM-adjudicated effects, stress mechanics, Strength reduction, necrotic damage per spell, rest recovery, and chance to lose Wish forever.
